name: interactive-terminal-playground
title: Interactive Terminal Playground
description: An embedded simulated developer terminal executing commands like help, inspect, and test with live output.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Interactive Terminal Playground Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
